title: RotaryCell: Making an unmodified rotary phone work over LTE with an ESP32-S3
summary: A maker project that transforms a vintage rotary phone into a functional LTE-capable telephone using an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, bridging nostalgic analog hardware with modern cellular network technology.
problem_solved: Enables obsolete rotary phones to make calls over modern LTE networks instead of being discarded.
why_valuable: Preserves vintage hardware while demonstrating creative IoT integration, giving new life to classic devices that would otherwise become decorative items.
